purpose: Prevent the shared token GEX/Gex from creating false lineage edges between unrelated JANUS branches while preserving source-confirmed conceptual relatives as distinct runtime nodes.

GEX_GAMMA_EXPOSURE.definition: gradient-volatility proxy derived from grad_norm relative to grad_norm_ema
GEX_GAMMA_EXPOSURE.observed_runtime_action: positive threshold reduces lr_scale; negative threshold slightly increases lr_scale; lr_scale is clamped

GEX_BLOCK_HUNTER_KENSHI.identity: Gex block-candidate hunter / extreme-tail router plus a named GEX faction in the virtual world
GEX_BLOCK_HUNTER_KENSHI.cli_definition: --gex enables Gex block-candidate hunter / extreme-tail router
GEX_BLOCK_HUNTER_KENSHI.kenshi_roles: GEX is one faction among SLIME, RAMANUJAN, GEX, ARTMONEY, DIRAC, GIMLET and NOMADS; faction_pressure is the sum of current virtual-agent scores by faction
GEX_BLOCK_HUNTER_KENSHI.runtime_effect: high gex_pressure increases HUNTER role bonus; Gex policy can influence routing modes/guards in this experimental search harness
GEX_BLOCK_HUNTER_KENSHI.authority: experimental search-routing telemetry only; no SHA-256 prediction or break authority

TAIL_GEX_LANE_CHARACTERIZATION.state: TailGexLaneStats per lane: hashes, z16..z38 tail counters, bestZ, densityEma, tailGex, confidence, sign, weightPct
TAIL_GEX_LANE_CHARACTERIZATION.mechanism: weighted rare-tail points per hash are converted to a density EMA; gamma is the current density EMA minus its previous value; exposure depends on accumulated hashes; confidence also depends on tail sample count and rare-tail strength
TAIL_GEX_LANE_CHARACTERIZATION.runtime_effect: scheduler-only lane/stride/batch weighting with exploration floor and maximum weight cap
TAIL_GEX_LANE_CHARACTERIZATION.hard_boundary: targetBits, job bytes, header, wire and submit protocol are not changed by the TailGEX allocator; virtual reward shaping does not fabricate shares
TAIL_GEX_LANE_CHARACTERIZATION.relationship_to_gamma_exposure: CONCEPTUAL_RELATIVE_ONLY: both use a gamma/exposure metaphor, but variables, formula, domain and control surface are different
TAIL_GEX_LANE_CHARACTERIZATION.authority: lane-allocation telemetry/heuristic only; no cryptographic prediction authority

GEX_GAME_CHARACTER.identity: Gex the Gecko / THE GREEN CHANNEL

CORE_GEX.rule: Do not create this node by concatenating nearby Core and GEX mentions.

historical_training_note.description: An early explanatory passage contains conflicting prose about the sign of JGPT Gamma Exposure. The implemented JGPT code consistently treats rising grad_norm relative to EMA as positive GEX and responds by lowering lr_scale.
historical_training_note.provenance_rule: Preserve the early contradiction rather than silently normalizing the historical text.

routing_rule: Require source-level context before routing GEX to a namespace.
JGPT Gamma Exposure, Gex block-hunter/Kenshi faction, Gladius TailGEX and Gex the Gecko are four distinct recovered contexts unless a source explicitly creates a bridge.
Conceptual reuse of gamma/exposure is a relation, not node identity.
A cultural analogy may be stored as SYMBOLIC_RELATION only and must not inherit runtime authority.
A training heuristic must not inherit search-routing or lane-allocation authority, and vice versa.
